verdict.rationale: Snyk documents only one AI-backed triage capability: DeepCode AI feeds a context-aware risk score that weighs package popularity, reachability of vulnerable code and exploit maturity. This helps prioritize findings and cut noise. The other documented features do not count as AI triage: source-to-sink flow visualization is a static view, the ignore option is manual suppression, and the Remediation Agent fixes issues rather than triaging them. Missing for 10: AI-generated explanations of findings, AI deduplication of findings, explicit AI false-positive flagging, and independent or hands-on corroboration that AI triage reduces noise.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to triage findings — explaining them, deduplicating, and flagging likely false positives

citations.quote: DeepCode AI supports Snyk’s context-aware risk scoring, assessing the popularity of the affected package and the reachability of vulnerable code, all while monitoring the maturity of available exploits.
Sort by and prioritize the more important issues by incorporating factors such as issue prevalence, ease of fix, and risk factor into a single risk score.
